title: Persona Engine — Conversation Schema
description: Schema for a single conversation in the Persona Engine dataset pipeline. Each line in a JSONL dataset file should conform to this schema.

persona_id.description: Identifier of the target persona in this conversation.

metadata.description: Optional top-level metadata for the conversation.

messages.description: Ordered list of messages in the conversation.

text.description: The message content. Preserve original formatting, emojis, slang, and language mixing.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the message, if available.

metadata.description: Per-message metadata (e.g., media indicators, reply context).
